description: Expected outcomes of the pinned Morphir conformance cases for the v3 and v4 codec bundles. IDs are stable. "root" names the Smithy root shape a case checks; TODO entries are filled in by tasks 6.2 and 7.1. expected is valid (decode and re-encode to the canonical fence), invalid (refuse with the diagnostic) or other-node (decodes as expectNode, not as the case node). Only JSON and text fences are listed; YAML fences, document trees, support-table parsing and filesystem naming cases are out of scope. Run mise run morphir:codecs:vendor -- --check to verify every file, line, fence, pointer and lexeme.
